analysis.one_line_summary: Receipt-themed Black Friday promo graphic featuring the WavyTalk Blowout Boost Ionic Thermal Brush at $62.10 (30% off).
analysis.full_description: A square static promotional graphic designed like a crumpled store receipt against a dark textured purple-wine background. The top of the receipt displays the 'WAVYTALK' brand logo, followed by 'Black Friday' and the promotional price '$62.10 | 30% OFF'. Below, receipt line items list 'ITEM' and 'QTY', with 'BLOWOUT BOOST Ionic Thermal Brush' and quantity '1'. A photo cutout of the pink WavyTalk Blowout Boost thermal round brush is positioned in the center over the receipt. A purple circular sticker on the right reads 'TODAY ONLY'. Scraps of paper with barcodes and receipt headers appear in the upper-left and lower-right corners.
